channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 19
item.description:
92 development commits

NPC & AI

  • Fixed AI navigation: find closest edge now works, scientists correctly favor cover near walls, and agents no longer get stuck when navmesh tiles rebuild.
  • Improved pathfinding: agents use dtCorridor for smoother following and avoid getting wedged in navmesh corners.
  • Resolved tiger AI charging indefinitely at the base of vine trees.

Vehicles

  • Fixed server error in ModularCar decay damage caused by vehicle pooling.
  • Boat interaction UI now only shows fuel and engine controls to the driver.

Animals

  • Livestock now retain parent information and include a debug console variable for completing pregnancies.
  • Infant animals remain close to their mother.

Items & Weapons

  • Enabled read/write access on primitive loot box gibs, fixing related loot issues.
  • Corrected pooling logic for pool balls, preventing incorrect behavior.
  • Enabled pooling for thrown darts, improving performance and consistency.
  • Glass AK now hides bullet models when ammo is depleted.

Monuments & Structures

  • Fixed blocker mesh issues and switched monument avoidance to use the PreventBuildingMonumentTag registry.
  • Added animal fence/gate placement module and introduced new S2P monuments such as military tunnel, oilrig, and launch site.

Gameplay & Systems

  • Re‑enabled unsafe scripting access for clients.
  • Adjusted entity flag toggles to resolve post‑change issues.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 18
item.description:
144 development commits

Gameplay & AI

  • Foundations with staircases now correctly pass line‑of‑sight checks for soft‑side melee damage.
  • Flag collision issues resolved, including the RidableHorse flag.
  • Honey bandage now correctly triggers its healing effects.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 17
item.description:
48 development commits

Animals & Breeding

  • All livestock animals now have correct genders and breeding state machine, fixing the issue where every animal was female.
  • Bull prefab added, introducing bulls as a new breedable livestock animal.

Items & Equipment

  • Medical honey bandage now correctly triggers its healing effects.
  • Water bucket UI fixed so players can transfer water into a held bucket.
  • Battery items now properly receive additional data via client RPC.

UI & Server Connectivity

  • Nexus connect modal UI bugs fixed: map button now enables, map no longer squishes, and overall modal stability improved.
  • Servers with Nexus enabled are now tagged with "nexuszone", hidden from the server list by default, and expose Nexus info in A2S rules.
  • MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent changes.
  • UI rows alignment corrected, removing the left offset on non-keyframable rows.

Vehicles

  • Vehicle pooling now detaches runtime‑parented children before pooling, preventing NRE spamming.

Gameplay & World

  • Underwater Labs windows refraction texture fixed, improving visibility inside labs.
